_comment: The respawn rig's vantages (scripts/verify-respawn.js, `just verify-respawn`; docs/design/game-setting-and-intro.md rung 2, 2026-11-21). Run in order in one boot by scripts/probe-sweep.js: the bedroom's respawner seen from the room, the death screen's list of where to wake over it, a respawn at the home's respawner from the ground floor (it must wake upstairs, in the bedroom), and a death and a respawn in General Services. Poses are home-local metres (x, eye y, z, yaw, pitch); yaw 0 looks toward -Z, at the bedroom's north wall where the pod stands (data/machines/home.ron respawn_pod_1, (37.5, 3.0, 30.518)). The rig's own home is the family homestead (the dev autopilot's).

vantages.desc: The homestead's respawner, in the main bedroom upstairs against its north wall, seen from the middle of the room.
vantages.expect: A tall pale grey-blue box, about as tall as a person and under a metre wide, standing against the bedroom's north wall between the nightstand and the desk.
regressions: no pod at all (the respawner row missing or not drawn)
the pod floating, sunk into the floor or through the wall

vantages.desc: The death screen over the bedroom: the lore's words and the list of where to wake, the usual place first.
vantages.expect: A card: 'Your body died. You did not.', the cause, the line about sleeping on the lifeline, 'Where to wake', a primary 'Wake at your home's respawner' with 'your usual place' under it, and 'Wake at General Services'.
regressions: YOU DIED with one Respawn button (the list missing)
a key showing instead of words

vantages.desc: Parked at the front door on the ground floor, the dead player presses 'Wake at your home's respawner'.
vantages.expect: Standing upstairs in the bedroom, right in front of the respawner's door, looking at it.
regressions: still at the front door (the respawn ignored the pod)
on the ground floor under the bedroom

vantages.desc: From the front door again: die, then press 'Wake at General Services'.
vantages.expect: Standing in General Services' hall beside the public respawner, on the ground floor of the ship.
regressions: at the front door or in the Commons instead
